videos.description: Slide lecture: high-contrast slide text, slide transitions and an aligned timestamped transcript.
videos.sample_transcript:
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000 [slide_area] term=slide_transition action=define status=INTRO We define a slide transition.
00:00:03,000 --> 00:00:05,000 [slide_area] step=1 term=gradient action=explain status=ACTIVE Step one, identify the key term gradient.
00:00:05,000 --> 00:00:07,000 [slide_area] step=2 term=optical_flow action=compare status=ACTIVE Definition: optical flow measures apparent motion.
00:00:07,000 --> 00:00:09,000 [slide_area] step=3 term=keyframe action=summarize status=DONE Keyframes mark high change frames.
00:00:09,000 --> 00:00:11,000 [slide_area] term=visual_pulse action=recap status=DONE Summary of the lecture.

videos.description: Hands-on workbench demo: continuous hand/tool motion in a tool zone with small labels and step notes.
videos.sample_transcript:
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000 [tool_zone] step=1 action=open_tool status=START Open the tool.
00:00:03,000 --> 00:00:05,000 [tool_zone] step=2 action=align_part status=ACTIVE Align the part with the marker.
00:00:05,000 --> 00:00:07,000 [tool_zone] step=3 action=fasten status=ACTIVE Fasten the fitting.
00:00:07,000 --> 00:00:09,000 [tool_zone] step=4 action=verify status=DONE Verify the connection.
00:00:09,000 --> 00:00:11,000 [tool_zone] step=5 action=cleanup status=DONE Clean up the work area.
